summary: Independent W4 audit of archives/k/kauth5/5.116.0 (KDE Frameworks 5 KAuth, Qt5) plus its knowledge draft - verdict PASS, no P0/P1 blockers. Verified from the real files on disk and the W3/CI logs, not only from the generated input summary. (1) No deception: test_package/test.cpp and test_kauth5_ohos.cpp genuinely construct KAuth::Action, round-trip name/detailsV2/arguments/helperId, and call status()/execute()/ActionReply factories; both consumer binaries actually executed on the device. The excluded KAuthHelperTest is reported as excluded (never as passed) consistently in conanfile.py, manifest.yaml, notes.md, test_package/MANIFEST.yml, reports/test-report.md and reports/pr-body.md; pass rates are stated with three explicit denominators (1/2, 1/1, 1/4) so nothing is inflated; no placeholder text remains. (2) R8/R52: patch 0001-CMakeLists.txt.patch only comments out ecm_install_po_files_as_qm(poqm); no platform-macro injection and no stub/return-0 bypass. (3) R32/R33 clean (no == "Linux", no bare $CC/$CFLAGS in self.run()); R26 is not applicable - kauth5 ships no system-same-name library. (4) R39: conandata.yml uses the official download.kde.org URL first plus authoritative mirrors, with a valid 64-hex sha256; no file:// path; no hardcoded conan remote inside conanfile.py. (5) R37/W2: 5.116.0 is correct for a first publish and the change is atomic - exactly one software directory plus its knowledge draft. (6) R28/R34/L0: test_package/ present with real API-calling sources and MANIFEST.yml (assertion_count 45) with an honest upstream declaration. (7) Style/YAML/patch-naming compliant.
